facts.fact: The Plateforme de Dématérialisation des Recettes des Collectivités Locales (PDRCL) was designed, integrated and is managed by ACSI, an agency under the finance ministry, which presented it as a purely national development.

The finance ministry says PDRCL has a back-office module for local government agents and a market-collector module (Zando collecte) that enrols taxpayers, records revenues by payment mode and tracks each taxpayer's operations.
